I am looking for a movie that is a comedy. It should be funny and light-hearted, but also have some substance. I've seen "The Grand Budapest Hotel" and "Bridesmaids" before and enjoyed them both. Can you recommend something similar? Also, do you know if there's any good Indian comedy movies out there? Thank you! #######
Certainly! Given your preferences for a comedy that is both funny and light-hearted while also having substance, here are a few recommendations:

1. **"The Big Sick" (2017)** - This film is based on a real-life story and blends humor with poignant moments. It’s directed by Michael Showalter and stars Kumail Nanjiani and Zoe Kazan. The movie is a heartwarming tale that will make you laugh and cry in equal measure. 2. **"The Intern" (2015)** - Starring Robert De Niro and Anne Hathaway, this film is about an elderly man who becomes a part-time intern at a fashion startup. It’s a delightful mix of comedy and drama that explores themes of generational differences and personal growth. 3. **"Crazy Rich Asians" (2018)** - Directed by Jon M. Chu, this movie is a modern romantic comedy that combines humor with cultural richness. It features an ensemble cast and is set against the backdrop of lavish Asian weddings and social gatherings. 4.
